diagnostic_interpretation: Subset CV/SD describes a different score-conditioned sample; a smaller subset variance is not proof of lower stochastic noise. Incomplete original metrics remain null, without a complete-case submean.
Interval narrowing is not presumed or required. Median/Winsorized paired-log contrasts estimate different quantities from raw mean resource ratios.
Any original scope, accounting or execution failure still blocks the original favorable validity gate, including when its tuple is trimmed.
Leave-one-task-out values assess the five accepted questions; they are not a new task selection or population interval.
The original fifty pairs are all retained; no previous campaign or supplementary wave is pooled.

selected_pair_overlap.interpretation: Separate score-conditioned means; asymmetric retention is not a new equally retained paired sample.

filter_variability_diagnostics.scope: Fixed-bank diagnostic only. No omitted task or selected trial is removed from the primary result.

measurement_scope: Pinned-main opencode-session-tree-v1: recursively counted root/descendant input (uncached+cache-read+cache-write), output and tool calls. Not provider billing or all unlinked background requests. Local embeddings have no remote embedding API token total.
quality_scope: Same-model pinned-main GLM SWE-QA self-judge total100, not the prior original-rubric factual score or strict e2e gate.

bootstrap.unit: whole original pair within each fixed task

limits: Score bounds are identification bounds, not confidence intervals.
Robust paired-log contrasts and score-conditioned trimmed means estimate different quantities from raw arithmetic-mean resource ratios.
Task MAD is a separately labelled diagnostic; the primary never drops a question.
Filtering cannot repair scope, accounting or retrieval failures.
Pointwise fixed-bank intervals are not population or multiple-comparison guarantees.
statistics.macro_resource_basis: ratio of equal-weight task/profile arithmetic means; robust contrasts aggregate their fixed-task log estimates separately

time_scope: Pinned-main Harbor agent_execution.seconds minus native recursive usage collection time; source/session integrity audit overhead is included and separately retained. Independent outer-slot wall includes cold container, native installation/local model download/index, collection and cleanup; excludes CI queue and host source export.

quality_evaluation_wave.method: uniform postrun GLM SWE-QA wave over all100 planned positions
